## Key Concepts

### Coefficient of variation (CV)

- Relative measure of sampling error
 - Low CV < 15% --> high reliability
 - Medium CV = 15-30% --> moderate reliability
 - High CV > 30% --> low reliability

### Measures of Uncertainty

- Standard error (SE): MOE / 1.645
- Derived uncertainty: margins of error of numerator and denominator can't be simply computed
  - moe_sum   -> adding estimates together
  - moe_prop  -> one estimate as share of another
  - moe_ratio -> one not a subset of another

### Change Over Time

- Compare non-overlapping intervals: calculate change between intervals and uncertainty of both estimates
- SE_diff: sqrt(SE1^2 + SE2^2)
- CI of Change: Difference +- (1.645 * SE_diff)
- CV = (SE / Estimate) x 100
- z = change / SE_diff
- significant = abs(z) > 1.645
